description: Non-adaptive flagship geometric Grover schedule (r=1.45 plus near-cap mirror-breaking rung at round(nmax/1.3) with canonical linear shot profile) paired with a two-stage continuous terminal estimator: exact coarse-grid global maximum likelihood + 25-point parabolic zoom to identify the winning basin mode, followed by fine-grid Gaussian-windowed local posterior centroid integration over [-0.75w, +0.75w] (c = 4.5 sigma_theta) around the mode. Smoothly averages skew and near-tied mirror modes while exponentially suppressing distant rival basins, reducing both C95 and C99 relative to global ML at zero extra query cost.
